text:
Guest: Hi, front desk? This is room four-twelve. I booked a king bed, and there are two twins in here.
Front desk: I'm sorry about that, sir. Let me check. Is it Mr. Grant?
Guest: Yes, Grant. I specifically requested a king. It's even on my confirmation.
Front desk: I see the note. It looks like the king rooms were full when you arrived and we assigned you what was available. I should have called you. I apologize.
Guest: And also it's really loud. There's a bar next door, and the bass is coming through the wall.
Front desk: Understood. I can move you to a king room on the sixth floor, at the back of the building. It'll be quieter. Would that work?
Guest: Yes. When?
Front desk: Give me fifteen minutes. A bellman will help with your bags. And I'll take thirty percent off tonight's rate for the inconvenience.
Guest: Okay. That's fair.

metadata.note: Hotel complaint: noisy room and wrong bed type
